patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with distinct background colors (white, light beige, orange, dark brown) to visually segment content.
A high-contrast palette featuring a vibrant orange accent against neutral backgrounds (white, light beige, and dark brown/black) to draw attention to key elements.

A sticky header composed of a top promotional banner and the main navigation bar remains visible at the top of the viewport. A temporary sticky banner with a countdown timer is present within the hero section, scrolling away with the hero content.
A prominent 'How to create your unique trophy' step-by-step guide uses large, illustrative icons and concise descriptions to simplify the customization process.
Product listings are presented in a consistent three-column grid layout, each item featuring an image, title, price, and a 'personalize' call-to-action button.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a sticky header for both a promotional banner and the main navigation, ensuring these elements are always accessible. A temporary sticky banner with a countdown timer is initially fixed at the bottom of the hero section but scrolls out of view as the user progresses down the page. Content sections simply scroll into view without any complex reveal or parallax animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, establishing a clear hierarchy, with subheadings also distinct in size and weight.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approximately 4-8px) is applied consistently to buttons and card edges, providing a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: The site employs a balanced spacing density, with airy sections for key informational blocks and a denser grid layout for product listings.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a warm, earthy palette combined with a vibrant orange accent creates an inviting yet energetic feel. The product imagery, featuring natural wood textures, is central to the design, making the unique offering of personalized wooden trophies and magnets feel tangible and special. The prominent, temporary sticky banner with a countdown timer for holiday delivery is also a notable feature.
